To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cyst fluids of schwannoma tumors contain factors that inhibit the proliferation of T and B lymphocytes, but not that of the tumor cells, and that this immunosuppression is mediated by TGF‐β.
the growth of the NV2Cd schwannoma cells is inhibited by the cytotoxic T‐cell response, but that the tumor cells escape elimination by the secretion of immunomodulatory factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms by which tumors escape the immune system.
a tumor‐cell specific cytotoxic‐ T lymphocyte response in rats.
the interaction of the immune system with tumors and the mechanisms by which the tumor can escape the cellular response.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the tumor‐derived factors are able to inhibit T‐cell proliferation, but not the proliferation of tumor cells.
the tumor cells can escape the immune system by the production of TGFβs.
the tumor‐induced T‐cell‐mediated immune response is not sufficient for elimination of the tumor cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
tumor cells can evade the cellular immune response, which is directed against them by the production of immunosuppressing factors.
the tumor‐cell‐induced cytotoxic T cells are not able to destroy the tumor cells because of the immunosuppressing factors produced by the tumor cells themselves.
tumor cells escape the immune response by the secretion of immunomodulating factors, which are also responsible for the growth of the tumor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the growth of tumors is not only determined by their genetic composition, but that they can modulate their growth environment by the production of growth‐promoting and ‐inhibiting factors.
tumor cells can escape elimination by cytotoxic T cells by producing immunosuppressive cytokines.
tumors can escape from the immune system by secreting growth‐modulating and immunosuppressive molecules.
